Commentary.Commentary: Right then! 267 to win for Pakistan to keep the series alive. In the first 2 games, 280 has been proved quite easy to chase down. But this is a slightly different pitch, expected to slow down, as was visible in Powerplay 3 with even Maxwell struggling to time his shots. Now, add the rain factor. Would that have spiced up the pitch? Will the ball skid on to the bat? Will the bowlers find it difficult to grip the ball? All these questions will be answered soon.

Pakistan bowled well but questions will be asked to Shoaib Malik as to why did Usman Khan did not bowl his full quota of 10 overs. He was instrumental in keeping Australia quiet in Powerplay 1, with figures of 4-2-8-1 at that stage. Junaid Khan started well but took a beating at the death. The young Hasnain had a poor outing today. But the spin trio of Yasir, Imad and Sohail kept Australia quiet - 3/116 in 27 overs combined.

For a change, Aaron Finch won the toss this afternoon and had no hesitation in batting first. The visitors lost two wickets pretty quickly, with the in-form Khawaja bagging a duck. But the 84-run stand between Finch and Handscomb brought the Aussies back on track. The skipper battled on till the 42nd over but then missed out on his century. However, just when Australia seemed to be in a bit of bother, Maxwell put on a Big Show.

One man scores 90, another scores 71 - that is how this score of 266 has been largely built for Australia. Aaron Finch laid the platform, Peter Handscomb played a good supporting role and towards the end, Glenn Maxwell teed off. 90 runs came in the last 10 overs, which might prove decisive.

SIX! Wonderful timing on that! Some way to end the innings by Carey. A short ball, around middle and off, coming in to the batsman, Carey frees his arms and muscles the pull over mid-wicket! AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 266/6!
A lovely slower bouncer outside off, Alex leaps and tries the upper cut but misses. He looks at the square leg umpire for a wide call but gets nothing.
Dropped short, Carey pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple.
This is heaved through mid-wicket for a single.
A pinpoint yorker, around middle, dug out to the leg side, back to the bowler.
Outside off, Carey backs away and pushes it to the off side for a single.
Oops... it is raining again! It is getting pretty heavy and the batsmen are standing in the middle but the umpires are happy to continue.
Outside off, a slash and a miss.
Heaves it down to long on for a single.
This time Alex slices it over cover for another brace.
Full on middle and off, Carey is early into his flick and scoops it in the air. Mistimes it but luckily for him, the ball lands in between deep mid-wicket and long on. Two runs taken.
Outside off, dabbed to third man for a run.
Full on middle, chipped towards long on for a single.
Pat Cummins walks in at number 8, replacing Maxwell.

OUT! Direct hit and Maxi is gone! Well, a bit too late but Pakistan will take it. This could be the difference between a 260 and a 275. With Maxwell around, anything could have been achieved. A slower ball, outside off, short in length, Maxi looked to pull but missed. He was very careless to stand out of his crease and an alert Rizwan just over-arms at the stumps. Bull's eye and Maxwell has to go. Wonderful knock, has given his team something to defend.
Into the pads, worked towards mid-wicket for one.
Excellent yorker on middle, dug out to the leg side for a run.
FOUR! Lovely shot. Full and outside off, Maxwell opens the face of the bat and steers it behind point for a boundary!
A lovely slower ball bouncer, Maxwell ducks or rather sways away. He then looks at the square leg umpire for a wide call but does not get it.
Full and around middle, swung over mid-wicket for a couple.
Junaid Khan is back on. 7-0-40-1 so far.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.

FOUR! That is a Maxwell special. Not sure how to describe it. But still, will try. First a furious full toss from Usman. Maxwell has no time to see it. Closes his eyes and just plays the whip-pull out of reflex. The ball goes in the air towards deep backward square leg where Junaid Khan comes charging in but is not able to get to the ball. Misses it and it is a boundary.
On middle and leg, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Outside off, a slash and a miss from Maxi.
Full on middle, lofted down to long on where Umar Akmal manages to stop it  with a dive to his left. But cannot stop the batsmen  from returning for the second.
A flat-batted shot by Carey takes the ball through long on for a single.
Usman Shinwari is back into the attack.
Third two on the trot! Excellent batting with big boundaries. On a length outside off, angled away by Maxwell through to the right of third man. Two taken easily. 17 runs off the over!
Another couple! Pakistan are being run ragged out here. Maxwell pushes this length ball through the covers and runs really fast to turn around and come back for the second.

Two runs taken again and this is once more excellent running by the two batsmen. A length ball, Maxwell swings through the line but gets an inside edge that runs fine on the leg side. Great running to complete two there.

SIX! That is a terrific shot and it brings up the 50 for the Big Show! His 17th in ODIs. He is turning on the heat out here and every run he adds here is going to hurt Pakistan, especially Imam. A bouncer aimed at the ribs of Maxwell, he just takes his eyes off the ball and swats the ball. It flies off the top edge and over deep fine leg for a maximum.
FOUR! Short of a length and wide outside off, Maxwell frees his arm and cuts this away hard and in the gap through backward point. Boundary ensues, no stopping that!
Pulled away for a single to deep square leg.

Good running! A fuller ball on middle, Maxwell somehow manages to dig it out and gets it through mid-wicket. The batsmen really run well to come back for the second but that is not such good fielding in the deep.
On a length and Carey misses his flick to get hit on the pads. The batsmen take a quick single.
Misfield! Maxwell pushes this to cover but Masood has butter fingers and allows the ball to bobble through towards mid off. Single taken.
FOUR! The second of the over! Almost close to the same region as the first one. A short ball on the leg side, Maxwell comes inside the line and lifts it over fine leg for a boundary.
On a length outside off, going away from the right-hander, Maxwell hangs back and punches it away through cover for a couple of runs.

FOUR! Terrific beginning to the over for the batting side. Junaid bowls this at the body of Maxwell on a shorter length, Maxwell comes inside the line and just lifts it over backward square leg for a boundary. It was almost a maximum.

DROPPED! Imam has put down Maxwell and this could mean a difference of 20 runs to the final score. On a length outside off, Maxwell cuts it away aerially and the ball flies straight to Imam at point. He cannot react quickly enough and despite getting a hand to it, he cannot hold on. A single is taken.
Short of a length and aimed at the body of the southpaw, he manages to keep it out towards mid-wicket. A single is taken.
Lovely looking drive! Fuller length on middle, Carey gets inside the line and drives it past cover for a couple of runs. The 200 comes up for the visitors.
Wide outside off, Maxwell backs away and cuts it to deep cover slightly aerially for a single.
A length ball on the middle stump line, Carey tries to push at it but he gets an inside edge fine to the right of the keeper. A single is stolen.
On a length on top of middle stump, Carey pushes it from the crease towards point.
Mohammad Hasnain is back into the attack.
FOUR! A short ball, outside off, Maxwell pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary!
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
That ball has taken the inside edge onto the pads. They pick up a single.
Down the leg side, tucked fine for a run.
On middle and leg, tucked to the leg side for a single.
Full and around off, pushed to the off side.
Junaid Khan returns. 5-0-20-1 so far.
The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Full and down the leg side, Carey misses his sweep and is hit on the pads.
Alex Carey walks in at number 7, replacing his skipper.

OUT! CAUGHT! Finch departs. A fuller length delivery on off with a flight. Finch lofts it above mid on but finds Haris Sohail at the long on boundary. An easy catch for Haris Sohail to stop Finch getting another century in this series. A top flighted delivery by Shah, Finch was all set to muscle it out of the park, but fails.
Maxwell was looking for a scoop but fails to connect.
FOUR! A reverse sweep by Maxwell over the short third man for a boundary.

NOT OUT! The decision is reversed. Nothing on the Snickometer. Wonder where the noise came from? Outside off, Maxwell looked to punch it through the off side but missed. Rizwan pouched and appealed instantaneously and given the noise that everyone heard, the umpire raises his finger. Maxwell immediately signalled to Finch to go upstairs and replays supported him, with nothing on the Snickometer.
Maxwell is caught behind! But he has asked for a review. There was a noise...
Full on off, Maxi flicks it to mid-wicket for another single.
Finch pulls it for a single at fine leg.
Full on leg, Maxwell drives it to mid off for a single.
Back of a length around off, Maxwell pulls it with pure muscle power towards the mid-wicket region for a double.
Full on leg, Finch flicks it to square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery, Shah at mid-wicket misfields it which allows a single.
POWERPLAY 3 time. 5 fielders allowed outside the 30-yard circle. Can Australia get to 250? Pakistan have been very disciplined with the ball.
Down the leg side, flicked straight to deep mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman plays a pull shot to this short delivery. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Full and on the pads, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, flayed straight to point. We are getting to that stage where Maxwell wants to get on with it...
Down the leg side, Maxwell looks to sweep but misses and is hit on the pads.
Full and outside off, pushed to the off side.
A fuller length delivery on off, Finch hits it straight to mid off.
A back of a length around off, Maxwell pulls it to mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! A full length delivery on off, Maxwell drives it to mid off, Akmal at mid off gives a dive, but fails to stop the ball. The ball touches the boundary ropes.
A short delivery on off, Maxwell pulls it straight to mid-wicket.
A length ball on leg, Finch was looking to work it fine but the ball hits his pads. A soft appeal from bowler but umpire denies. A single taken.
A back of a length delivery on off, Finch punches it straight to covers.
A single to end the over as Finch punches this short one away to deep cover and keeps strike.
Another front foot defense from Aaron Finch. 3rd dot in a row.
Flatter one on middle, Finch gets his bat in front of the bat and pushes it back to bowler.
Pushed watchfully to mid-wicket by the batsman.
Cut away beautifully for a couple of runs by the Aussie skipper this time to deep point. Easy two there.
Flatter one on the pads, flicked by Finch to the fielder at 45 on the leg side.
Full on leg, Finch works it towards the square leg region for a single.

A back of length delivery on leg, Maxwell looks to work it towards the mid-wicket region but fails to get his bat on the ball. The ball strikes his pads and bowler goes for a appeal. The umpire shakes his head, as this was pitching outside leg. Maxwell completes a single in the mean time.
A well directed bouncer by Usman. Maxwell ducks under it. Umpire signals first bouncer for the over.
Slightly fuller than the previous one, Maxwell pushes it to mid on without moving too much.
Oooh! Some spice on that ball, on a length and bounces more than Maxwell expected. He looks to defend but it gets him on the glove before lobbing towards the off side.
A length ball on middle, Maxwell defends it from the crease.

Drinks break! Pakistan have picked up wickets at decent intervals but Australia's skipper Aaron Finch is going strong and he looks primed for his 3rd century in a row. Glenn Maxwell has joined him in the middle and the hosts will be looking to separate these two at the earliest as they can be really destructive at the final stages of the innings. On the other hand, the away side will hope for these two to bat as long as possible and score quick runs. Meanwhile, Usman Shinwari is back into the attack.
A back of a length on off, Finch tries a late cut, gets an inside edge onto the ground.
A short delivery on middle and leg, Finch keeps it away.

FOUR! A solid strike from Finch. A tossed up delivery on off, Finch strikes it above the bowler's head for a one bounce four. Once again Finch showing his absolute strength in his batting. A great strike from Aaron Finch.
A flatter delivery on middle, Finch defends it but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
A short delivery on off, Finch late cuts it to point.
A back of a length delivery on middle and leg, Finch places it straight to short fine leg.
Outside off, driven down to long off for a run.
Outside off, played straight to point.
Full on middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Maxwell looks to defend but is beaten by the away turn.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and down the leg side, Aaron misses his flick and is hit on the pads.
Outside off, pushed back to the bowler.
Full and outside off, watchfully defended.
Outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
Full and around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a single.
Yasir Shah is back on. 5-0-30-0 so far.
Full and outside off, chipped towards long off for one.
Full and down the leg side, Maxwell misses his flick and the ball goes off his pads towards fine leg. A leg bye taken.
This time Finch drives this through the covers and gets a single.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
A short delivery on off, Finch defends it from his back foot.
Full on leg, Finch paddles this one to the fine leg region for a double.
A back of a length delivery on off, Maxwell on his back foot cuts it through covers for a single.
Full on off, Maxwell hits it straight to covers.
A flighted delivery on leg, Finch pushes it long on for a single.
FOUR! Full on leg, Finch sweeps it to square leg boundary. Intelligent batting that by Finch.
On the off pole, Maxwell guides it to point. End of a successful over.
Glenn Maxwell walks out to bat.

OUT! Another batsman has been knocked over! Third of the four wickets have been bowled. Stoinis is the man walking back and he once again fails to make an impact. Imad who was normally firing it in, slows it up this time. It lands on the leg pole. Stoinis is done in by the pace as he looks to hit it over mid on. He is way too early in the shot. Misses, the ball hits his pads and then deflects onto the leg stump. Wickets at regular intervals are not letting Australia score freely.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side, Finch looks to flick but misses.
FOUR! Up and over! Finch this time gets hold of it and hits it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
This is on the shorter side, Stoinis pushes it down to long off for a run.
This is angled into the batsman, Finch looks to swing but it goes off the inner half towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
A flatter delivery on off, Stoinis defends it.
FOUR! A back of length on off, wicket holds the ball and comes late to the batsman. Stoinis gets on back foot, waits for the ball and pulls it to wide of long on for a boundary.
Full on leg, Finch flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
A flatter length delivery on off, Finch strikes it straight to covers.
A fuller length on off, Finch defends it.
On the shorter side, Finch goes back and punches it through covers for a run.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads.
The arm ball on the pads, Finch looks to flick but only gets an inside edge onto the pads.
This is on the pads, Finch works it through the leg side and takes two.
This is stroked to covers.
On the pads again, Stoinis looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. It rolls on the leg side and a single is taken.
This is worked around the corner for a single.
Back of a length on off, Finch punches it to covers for a single.
Back of a length delivery, Finch tries to play a cut but gets an inside edge unto the ground straight to the bowler.
The batsman fails to put bat on ball.
Finch drives this straight to covers.
Finch drives it through mid-off.
FOUR! A short pitched delivery outside off, Finch cuts it above point and the ball touches the boundary.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
This is driven back to the bowler.
On the stumps and it is kept out.
Back of a length delivery on off, Finch plays it late towards the third man region for a single.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Fifty for Finch! His golden patch continues. Raises his bat to acknowledge the applause. He needs to continue though. He works this through square leg and takes two to get to that milestone.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
He uses his feet and dances down to long on for a single.
On the stumps, Finch lunges and keeps it out.
This is worked through the leg side for a run.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Stoinis rocks onto the back foot and pushes it through covers for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Short and outside off, it is guided to point.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
Stoinis now strokes it through mid off for a run.
This is eased through covers for a run.
A dot to end as the last ball is pushed to covers.
On the stumps and the batter defends it.
Now eases this down to long off for another run.
Finch takes a few steps ahead and then flicks it through mid-wicket. Two results.
Shorter and outside off, Stoinis cuts it towards cover and gets off the mark.
Marcus Stoinis is the new man in.

OUT! CASTLED! What a delivery! Not a lot Handscomb could have done with that. Sohail slows this one up and bowls it on middle, Handscomb lunges and then looks to drive through the line. The ball though turns away, beats the outside edge and hits the off pole. Handscomb can't believe it as he trudges off slowly. Needed something special to break this stand as the two were looking at ease and Sohail provides it.
A flighted delivery on off, Finch hits it straight to the cover fielder. Dot ball. Just a single run from this over, a neat tidy over by Imad Wasim.
Full on middle, Finch hits it back to the bowler.
Imad bowls this one short, Finch defends it from his back foot.
A back of a length on off, Finch defends.
A flighted delivery on off, PH drives it to covers for a single.
A flighted delivery on leg, Handscomb blocks it.
Flatter and on the stumps, it is kept out.
Works it with the angle through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman gets to the pitch of the ball and connects.
This is eased down to long on for a single.
Finch goes back and pushes it to covers.

Close that! A direct and Finch was a goner there. He defends and then without seeing where the ball is takes off. Rizwan though quickly collects the ball and then looks to whip it onto the stumps but misses. Had he hit, Finch was short.
A back of a length delivery on off, Finch punches it to covers for a single.
A flighted delivery on leg, Finch flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Fuller delivery on leg, Finch keeps it away.
A flighted delivery on middle and leg, Finch drives it straight to mid on.
A back of a length delivery on off, Finch punches it straight to point.
Flatter delivery by Imad on off, defended with ease.
FOUR! Up and over! Lovely use of the feet once again by Handscomb and then flicking it over mid-wicket. No one in the deep and a boundary.
Another tossed up delivery on off, Finch hits it towards cover. The fielder misfields and a run is taken.
Driven through the covers by the batsman.
This is flatter and on off, Finch guides it towards point.
Gives this one nice amount of flight, Finch strokes it to covers.
Starts off with a slider on middle, Handscomb goes back and punches it down to long on for a run.
Haris Sohail is on now.
A flighted delivery on off, PH drives it to long off for another single.

A flatter delivery on off. PH already stepped out of the crease. Changed his stroke at last moment, instead of driving it to covers he placed this towards the third man region as he opened the face of the bat at last moment. Two runs added to the score.
A flighted delivery on off, Finch drives it from front foot to the cover region for a single.
A flighted delivery on off, Finch drives it to covers where the misfeild by Shan Masood at covers allows batsmen to take double.
A flighted delivery on off, PH drives it to long off. Single taken.
Shah tosses this up on off, Handscomb comes down the track and blocks it.
Flatter and on middle, Finch looks to flick but closes the face of the bat a little early, he gets a soft leading edge back to the bowler.
This is worked through mid-wicket, away from the fielder in the deep and two taken.
On the shorter side again, Finch goes back and pushes it to covers.
On the stumps, it is kept out.
This is hit down to long off for a run.
Handscomb is using his feet almost on every delivery, does the same again and strokes it to covers.
Well played in the end! Handscomb once again dances down the track but Yasir bowls it short. PH adjusts and hits it through covers for a single.
Slightly shorter and outside off, Finch slaps it through covers and takes another single.
Once again steps down the track and strokes it down to long on for a single.
Good use of the feet, good drive but straight to the fielder at cover.
A little too full, Finch hits it down to long on and takes a run.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They manage to come back for the second.
Lovely use of the feet there. Handscomb makes room and then caresses it through covers for two.
Well played in the end and a good single! The arm ball from Imad, it keeps coming in from outside off. Finch plays it late towards point and gets to the other end.
Works it with the angle through mid on and a single is taken.
Nicely driven through covers but to the man in deep for a single.
Flatter and on middle, PH goes back and eases it down to long off for a single.
Tosses it up nicely, Handscomb strokes it back to the bowler.
Imad Wasim is on now.
Back of a length delivery on off, Handscomb punches it from his back foot towards the sweeper cover region, another single from the over.
A flighted delivery on off, Finch from his crease drives this one to the mid off region for a single.
A nice tossed up delivery on off, Handscomb charges down the track and places it towards the mid off region for a single.
A tossed up delivery around middle, Handscomb tries to place it to mid-wicket but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Flighted delivery on middle, Handscomb hits it straight to the bowler.
A back of length delivery on off, Finch punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
A dot to end as the last ball finds the fielder at mid on.
FOUR! Right off the middle! Not a bad delivery that but a top shot by Handscomb. Length and on off, PH plants his front foot forward and on the up, strokes it through extra cover for a boundary.
Hits the length hard again on off, Finch this time gets it past point, down to third man for a single.
Closer to the off pole, Finch looks to guide it past point but can't do so.
A little too straight, Finch misses the flick, it hits him high on the pads and rolls beside the pitch. Handscomb wants a single but is sent back in time.
Back of a length on off, Finch stands tall and punches it to covers.
A back of a length this time, Handscomb rocks back and keeps it away.
A fuller length delivery on off, Handscomb hits it back to the bowler.
A floated delivery on leg this time, Finch flicks it to mid on for a single. Sensible batting by Aaron Finch by keeping the scoreboard moving.
A back of a length on off, Finch from his back foot punches it to deep cover for another double. 10 runs from 3 balls in this over already.

SIX! Top, top shot from Finch. A flighted delivery on around off, Finch from his front foot lifts this one above the bowler's head and that's all the way for a SIX! Aaron Finch showing his strength in this stroke, that is a powerful strike.
A flighted delivery on off, Finch leans forward and drives it to the wide mid off region for a double.
A single to end a tight over by Junaid! Finch works this wide of mid on and takes a run.

A huge shout by the bowler but the umpire is unmoved. Length and on middle, Finch once again looks to play across the line but misses, the ball hits him high on the pads. The bowler is pleading but the umpire shakes his head.
The slower ball and it is on a length outside off, Finch guides it to point.
Length again on off, Finch shuffles across and works it to mid-wicket.
Finch works it against the angle to the man at mid on.
Handscomb stays leg side of the delivery and then plays it late down to third man for a run.
A floated delivery on middle, Finch defends it.
Shah flights this delivery pitching on off. Finch watchfully drives it straight to the covers fielder.
A floated delivery on leg, Handscomb works it down to mid-wicket for a single.
A flighted delivery on off, Finch just taps it to mid off and runs for a single.
Back of a length delivery around leg, Finch blocks this one with leading edge onto the ground.
Shah starts with a flighted delivery on off, Finch defends this with ease.
Powerplay 2 has been signaled! Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Yasir Shah is on now.

Outrageous shot that! Handscomb just walks right across the stumps and then flicks it nonchalantly. Does not get a boundary but gets two. End of the first 10 and Australia have fought their way back into the game after losing two early. They are 48 for 2 after Powerplay 1.
Another flick shot, this time is is fielded by fine leg so just a run.
A little too straight again, this time the batsman flicks it towards mid-wicket who stops it with a dive.
Back of a length on off, Finch stands tall and keeps it out.
FOUR! 5th boundary in the last 8 balls. Runs coming thick and fast. On the pads, Finch this time does not miss out as he flicks it through square leg and the ball races away to the fence.
A stifled appeal! Length and around the leg pole, Finch looks to work it around the corner but misses to get hit high on the pads.
A full length delivery on leg, Handscomb just punches it straight to mid on. 16 runs from the over. Handscomb is looking in great touch.
FOUR! Another boundary from this over. Handscomb on a roll today. Shorter delivery this time, Handscomb pulls this one. The ball touches the square leg boundary.
FOUR! A back of length delivery this time pitching outside off. Handscomb easily lets the ball come to him and strikes it with precision in the cover region. Another boundary.
A back of length delivery. Handscomb watchfully defends it.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries. A fuller length delivery on middle this time. Handscomb shows full face of the bat. And strikes it straight back past the bowler.
FOUR! A fuller length delivery on leg, Handscomb just flicks it to the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Mohammad Hasnain is back on.
Back of a length on middle, the batter defends it off the back foot.
Good shot but only a couple! Length delivery outside off, Finch strokes it on the up through covers and bags a brace.
Length again around middle, Handscomb shuffles across and works it through square leg for a single.
Another length ball and another defensive stroke.
On the stumps, Handscomb gets right behind the line and defends it.
Length and on off, it is defended.

Another dot ball to end the over. A maiden from Usman. A back of length delivery on leg this time. Finch flicks it straight to mid-wicket. Usman bowled a top over, varied his length well and used the bounce on the deck.
Back of a length on leg, Finch just keeps it away. 5th dot ball from the over.
Fuller length on off, Finch blocks it.
A length delivery around middle, defended with ease.
A fuller length this time, very good variation of length from Usman. Finch blocks this one from his front foot.
A back of length delivery around leg, Finch just keeps it away.
Inside edge there! Just outside off, Handscomb looks to cut but the ball is a little too close to play that shot, he ends up chopping it to point.
Excellent shot to get off the mark! Slightly short and around off, Handscomb stands tall and punches it through covers for a couple.
Peter Handscomb walks out to the middle.

OUT! In the air... taken! Junaid makes an impact straightaway. The bowling change works wonders for Pakistan. Shaun Marsh has been dismissed for not a lot now. He though can consider himself a touch unlucky here. Firstly a good delivery from Khan, it is on the stumps and pitched on a length. It skids through. Marsh looks to defend but ends up playing outside the line. The ball takes the inside edge, hits the pad and then lobs as far as short mid-wicket. Masood at mid-wicket runs in and takes a sliding catch. The Pakistan players appeal and the umpire raises his finger. They do check for the front foot but it is fine. Australia in a spot of bother here.
Again a similar length and line, Marsh once again shoulders arms to it.
Just outside the off pole and Marsh covers his off pole and leaves it alone.
Length and outside off, Finch plays it with an angled bat towards third man for a single.
Junaid Khan is on now.
Make that 5 dots!  A good comeback by the bowler. Outside off, the batter does not offer a stroke.
Goes fuller and gets this one to swing. It comes in but Marsh though gets right behind the line and defends it. 4 dots after a boundary on the first ball.
On the 5th stump channel, Marsh goes back and defends it.
Another length ball, this is outside off though and the batsman does not play at it.
Goes back to bowling length does Khan, Marsh gets right behind the line and defends it out.
FOUR! This is right off the middle from Marsh! Elegance there. It is full and on off, Marsh just leans into it, does not go hard at it and just times it through covers for a boundary.
A fuller length delivery, Finch blocks it. Dot ball.
A back of a length this time, Hasnain is looking for variation from the track. He is changing his length in a very intelligent way. Marsh just guides it to third man uppishly for a single this time.

FOUR! Unfortunate for Hasnain, bowls this one fuller length on off, with it shaping in for the left-hander. Shaun Marsh with hard hands tries to drive it down to covers but gets an inside edge onto the ground. And ball goes to the fine leg boundary.
Hasnain bowls this one outside off stump, Marsh lets it go.
A back of length delivery with extra bounce, Shaun Marsh watchfully defends it on his back foot.
A full length delivery on leg, shaping into Marsh. Shaun Marsh just punches it to mid on. A hint of swing for Hasnain.

OHHH! The indecision almost cost Marsh there. Khan bowls it on a length outside off, it is in the corridor of uncertainty. Marsh is no sure whether to play at it or not. He then decides to leave but it is too late for that. The ball goes off the inside edge and past the off pole, towards fine leg for a single. Another good over by Khan comes to an end, a testing one.
Edgy! Back of a length on off, Finch looks to punch it off the back foot but the ball flies off the outside edge towards third man for a run.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
On the pads, Finch works it around the corner and takes two.
Stump-to-stump line and Finch blocks it with a forward defense.
A muted appeal but nothing from the umpire. Pitching outside leg. It was on the pads, Finch looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Also, the Australian players are seen wearing a black arm band in the remembrance of Bruce Yardley who expired today morning.

FOUR! A back of a length delivery on off, Marsh stays back on his back foot and waits for the ball to come to him. And just punches it in the gap between cover and point. First boundary for the day. Top shot from Shaun Marsh.
A back of a length delivery on off, Marsh blocks it.
A back of length delivery outside leg, with hint of swing. Marsh shoulders his arms on this. Umpire signals wide.
Hasnain changes is length this time, bowls this one back of a length outside off. Marsh leaves this one.
A fuller length delivery on off, Marsh lets it go.
First runs for the day for guests. Hasnain drifts down the leg side, Finch flicks it away to the mid wicket region for a single.
A fuller length delivery shaping away from Finch. He lets it go.
Mohammad Hasnain to bowl from the other end. Shaun Marsh comes out to bat at no. 3.

OUT! TIMBER! Usman Khan strikes with a peach of a delivery. A well-deserved wicket this as this was a top, top first over and he ends it in the best possible manner. He bowled an inswinger two balls prior which got the inside edge, the ball prior to this one was the away swinger which beat the outside edge. Went back to bringing it back in and gets the better of the in-form Khawaja. Also it is full. Khawaja is rooted to his crease as he looks to drive, leaves a big gap between bat and pad, the ball sneaks through and hits the stumps behind. Khan is pumped up and Pakistan are off to the ideal start. A wicket maiden to begin with by Usman.

Good stuff this! Got the last one to come back and gets this one to straighten. Also, he dragged his length back as he saw Khawaja walking down the wicket. The batter once again hangs his bat out and gets beaten.
Good delivery! Gets this one to jag back in after pitching around off. Khawaja has a tentative poke at it and gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Look to bring the ball back into the left-hander from outside off, no swing though and it is an easy leave for Khawaja.
Attacks the off pole this time, Khawaja though gets right behind the line and defends it confidently.
Yes, a little bit of inward movement but the line is a little outside off, Khawaja shoulders arms to it.

We are now set for the game to begin as it was just a passing shower. The players have made their way out to the middle. Usman Khawaja and Aaron Finch are the openers for Australia. Usman Khan will start the proceedings for the hosts. It is quite overcast, will the bowler get the ball to swing? We will find out as Usman comes running in.

We were all set for the match to begin but wait! We are not going to begin yet, it has started to rain! Would you believe it? The covers are coming on as well, looks like a passing shower though. Let's hope it is.
Pakistan Team News - The two people missing out from the previous game are Mohammad Abbas and Faheem Ashraf, with the latter being rested for all the remaining games.

Shoaib Malik, the Pakistani skipper says he wanted to bat first as well. Feels that as compared to the other two venues, there is more grass on this wicket as always in Abu Dhabi. Mentions his side has 2 changes with Usman Shinwari and Junaid Khan coming in. Reserves some praise for the youngster Mohammad Hasnain who generates lots of pace and is an exciting prospect.

Aaron Finch, the Australian skipper says that the wicket looks good and wants to put a score on the board. Informs us that his side have 2 changes from the previous game with Pat Cummins and Jason Behrendorff coming in to replace the duo of Jhye Richardson and Nathan Coulter-Nile. Is pretty happy with his own form and would like to continue batting like he did in Sharjah.
TOSS - Australia have won the toss and elected to bat first.

PITCH REPORT - The analyst, Bazid Khan says that conditions are pretty humid around here, almost 75 per cent. Coming to the surface, he informs us that it is different to the normal Abu Dhabi surfaces as it has a lot of grass covering as opposed to the usual ones. He mentions that usually the pitch slows down in the second half out here but tonight it might actually come on better to the bat off the surface due to the grass cover. Reminds us that the D/L method might come into play as there seem to showers around in the area.

Welcome to the third ODI of this 5-match series between Pakistan and Australia in the United Arab Emirates. The visiting side have been excellent so far and comfortably chased down two 280-plus scores that the hosts had put up in the first two games. The Men in Green will have to pull their socks up if they want to keep the series alive. They will hope that they can begin their resurrection at Abu Dhabi. On the other hand, the Kangaroos would like to not allow any kind of chance for the home side to come back in the rubber and continue their domination. With the surface expected to be on the slower side as compared to Sharjah and some chances of rain around, a lot might depend on the coin flip. It's not too far away. Stay tuned...
